definition_zh: 泊位；停泊地；（车、船上的）卧铺；安全距离；（v.）停泊
definition_en: a place where a ship moors, a sleeping place on a ship or train, or a safe distance; as a verb, to moor
core_image: 港口里那条系着缆绳、正好容纳一条船的水位
scene: 缆绳抛上岸，船长把船稳稳靠进标好的空位。The harbourmaster guided the ferry into its berth.
sceneCN: 这里 berth 是「泊位、停泊位」（第 1 个义项：船在港内的固定位置）；句意是港务长引导渡轮驶入指定泊位。

derivatives.zh: 拼写相近的英语本族词，义为「出生」，与 berth 词源无直接关系
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「停泊；泊位安排」

senses.title: A place for a ship to moor
senses.definition: a space in a harbour where a ship can be tied up
senses.definitionCN: 港内供船只系缆停靠的位置
senses.example: The harbourmaster guided the ferry into its berth.
senses.exampleCN: 港务长引导渡轮驶入指定泊位。
senses.why: The word grew from bearing, the room a ship needs to lie at ease.
senses.whyCN: 该词由「容纳的空间」义发展而来，指船安放所需的余地。

senses.title: A sleeping place on a ship or train
senses.definition: a built-in bed in a ship's cabin or a railway carriage
senses.definitionCN: 船舱或火车车厢内的固定床铺
senses.example: He climbed into the upper berth as the train rolled out.
senses.exampleCN: 火车启动时他爬上了上铺。
senses.why: A ship's resting place became a traveller's resting place.
senses.whyCN: 「船的安放之处」转为「旅人的安睡之处」。

senses.title: A safe distance
senses.definition: enough space to keep clear of danger, as in give a wide berth
senses.definitionCN: 与危险保持的充分间距，如 give a wide berth
senses.example: Sailors give a wide berth to the reef's sharp edge.
senses.exampleCN: 水手们对礁石锋利的边缘敬而远之。
senses.why: The mooring room widens metaphorically to any safe margin.
senses.whyCN: 「泊位余地」在比喻中扩大为任何安全余量。

intro.en: Berth probably comes from bear, meaning the space in which a ship can lie.
intro.cn: berth 一般认为源自 bear，指船能安然容纳的空间（来源不确定）。

items.en: beran meant to carry, to bear.
items.cn: 古英语 beran 意为「承载」。

items.en: sea use of berth is first recorded in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: berth 的海上用法最早见于十七世纪记录。

items.en: it meant sea room, then an allocated mooring place.
items.cn: 它先指可供回旋的海面空间，后指分配的泊位。

items.en: give a wide berth arose from keeping a ship at a safe distance.
items.cn: 十八世纪 give a wide berth 由船只保持安全距离而来。

items.en: railway sleepers borrowed the word for their built-in beds.
items.cn: 铁路卧铺借用了这个词指车厢内的床铺。

note.en: The look-alike group shares spelling or the bear root; the near-meaning group gathers mooring and rest places.
note.cn: 形近组共享拼写或 bear 词根；近义组汇集停泊与歇息之处。

entries.definitionCN: 出生——同音异义词，词源无关
承载——一般认为 berth 的词源动词

entries.definition: a direction, or the way one carries oneself
entries.definitionCN: 方位；仪态——一般认为与 berth 同出 bear

entries.definition: a place or ropes for fastening a ship
a place where ships load and unload

entries.definitionCN: 卧铺车厢；berth 指其中的铺位

normalIntro.en: Berth is sea room: the space where a ship rests.
normalIntro.cn: berth 是海上的「安放余地」：船歇脚的位置。

normal.en: Give a wide berth means keep far away.
normal.cn: give a wide berth 指敬而远之。

normal.en: An upper berth is the higher bed.

normal.cn: 动词 berthed 指已停泊。

normal.en: Berth and birth sound the same.
A harbour is full of berths.

abstract.en: See ropes pulled tight as a ship settles.
abstract.cn: 看缆绳绷紧、船身安稳落定。

abstract.en: Feel the train rocking you in a narrow bed.
abstract.cn: 感受窄床上火车的轻晃。

abstract.en: Picture stepping aside from a growling dog.
abstract.cn: 想象避开龇牙的狗绕道而行。

examples.en: The harbourmaster guided the ferry into its berth.
examples.cn: 港务长引导渡轮驶入指定泊位。

examples.en: He climbed into the upper berth as the train rolled out.
examples.cn: 火车启动时他爬上了上铺。

examples.en: Sailors give a wide berth to the reef's sharp edge.
examples.cn: 水手们对礁石锋利的边缘敬而远之。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泊·斯」——泊位就是船停泊的那个位置。

root: 一般认为源自古英语 beran「承载」，指船安然容身的空间；海上用法首见于十七世纪记录（确切来源不确定），由「回旋余地」发展为「泊位」，再引申「卧铺」与「安全距离」，与 birth「出生」同音但词源无关。

sensesIntro.en: One sea word slides from a mooring place to a train bed to a safe margin.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个海词，从泊位滑到卧铺，再到比喻中的安全距离。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a roped space in harbour sized for one ship.
core.cn: 核心意象：港内系着缆绳、恰好容纳一船的水位。

intro.en: Berth is a single sea word grown from the verb bear.
intro.cn: berth 是由动词 bear 生长出的单个海词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the likely root is Old English beran.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词源一般认为在古英语 beran。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「停泊」
同根名词，义为「泊位费；泊位设备」
